title: Memoize
description:
Implement a `memoize` function that caches the results of a function call based on its first argument.

**Example:**
```js
const memoAdd = memoize((n) => n + 1);
memoAdd(5); // 6 — computed
memoAdd(5); // 6 — cached (fn not called again)
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using an object as cache (cache[arg]) which coerces keys to strings. Map handles all value types correctly. Also checking truthiness of cached value instead of `cache.has(arg)` misses cached falsy values.
